plan.text: Win the diamond lead with South's ace and develop clubs immediately. Cash the club ace, lead a low club to dummy's queen, then return a club toward the king, adjusting to revealed distribution. A 3–2 break gives ten tricks; against 4–1, concede a club to establish the ninth trick. Preserve major-suit entries to reach South's established clubs, and avoid unnecessary risks for overtricks.

advice.publicReason: Play low and win in hand. Five outside winners mean we need four club tricks; a normal club break supplies these even if we concede one club.
